target: CORRECTION to UCT-METHOD-0001 — what is actually pointer-gated
action: Read the real gating in origin/master instead of assuming it
response: useIsTouch() = MQ.touchDown = '(max-width: 1024px)' — a WIDTH query, not a pointer query. Sheet.jsx, ContextPopover.jsx, TickerActions.jsx, TickerPopup.jsx and ChartContextMenu.jsx all gate on useIsTouch, so ALL of them take their touch branch in a 390px frame. The only genuine (pointer: coarse) gate on the chart is the module-level _COARSE_POINTER const in ChartDrawingOverlay.jsx (plus RowSpark and a GlobalVideoLayer audio flag).
result: ⛔ THE UNVERIFIED SET IS FAR SMALLER THAN I CLAIMED — eight behaviours, not 'most touch affordances'
notes: ⛔ CORRECTS MY OWN UCT-METHOD-0001, which said UCT 'gates several touch affordances on pointer:coarse or useIsTouch — notably DrawingQuickBar, the long-press ContextPopover, and Sheet's touch variants. NONE of those could fire in this harness.' Two of those three DO fire, because useIsTouch is width-based. The eight behaviours actually behind _COARSE_POINTER are: HIT_THRESHOLD 15px vs 8px (the touch grab radius), HANDLE_R 7px vs 4px plus a halo, a wrapper listener (L703), AUTO-SELECT AFTER PLACEMENT (L2158), a touch-only wrapper effect (L2310), the 'tap two points' coach chip (L2642), DrawingQuickBar (L2686), and sheet={_COARSE_POINTER} on DrawingContextMenu (L2735). ⭐ That list matters because FOUR of them are precisely the P1 behaviours I recorded UCT as LACKING.

action: Place a horizontal line, then open its context menu (useLongPress accepts right-click, so one binding serves both inputs)
response: A dark anchored menu with SEVEN rows: 'Color' (gold swatch + line-style preview + submenu chevron) | 'Set level…' | 'Set alert…' | 'Duplicate' | 'Lock' | 'Save as default' | 'Delete Drawing' (red)
result: ⭐⭐ UCT HAS OBJECT → ALERT AND TYPE-AN-EXACT-PRICE ON DRAWINGS
url: self-measured live on https://uctintelligence.com/charts in a 390x844 frame, 2026-09-07
notes: ⭐⭐ THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT CORRECTION IN THE UCT LANE and it goes in UCT's favour. 'Set alert…' on a drawing IS primitive P2 — object → alert — and UCT has it. 'Set level…' (type an exact price) is UCT's answer to touch imprecision and is the direct analogue of TradingView's Coordinates tab (DRAW-0034) and of its 'Draw horizontal line at 723.62'. 'Save as default' has no TradingView mobile equivalent I found. ⚠️ OPEN: whether 'Set alert…' PRE-FILLS from the drawing's own price could not be confirmed — the menu row did not respond to synthetic taps or to real clicks through the frame, and the renderer began timing out, so I stopped per the bounded-investigation rule rather than hammering it. That one question decides whether this is PARITY or PARTIAL against TradingView's always-pre-filled menu.

target: CORRECTION to UCT-ALERT-0001 — alert entry points
action: Re-count the routes to an alert after finding the drawing context menu
response: There are at least TWO routes, not one: (a) More tools > Set price alert… > TYPE the price > Alert above/below; (b) place or select a drawing > context menu > 'Set alert…'.
result: ⛔ UCT HAS AN OBJECT → ALERT PATH; MY EARLIER ROW SAID IT HAD ONLY THE TYPE-IT-YOURSELF PATH
notes: ⛔ CORRECTS UCT-ALERT-0001's framing. That row's measured fact stands — the More-tools alert sheet opens with an EMPTY price field and requires typing, which still falsifies TV-IOS-ALERT-0008's 'seeds from the live price' claim. What was wrong was the CONCLUSION drawn from it ('UCT has one alert door, in a menu, that requires typing a number'). It has a second, object-anchored door. ⭐ The remaining measured gaps against TradingView are narrower and more specific: (1) no alert from an ARBITRARY chart price (TradingView: long-press → ⊕ → Add alert, 3 gestures, no typing — UCT: no long-press action on the bare chart at all, see UCT-CHART-0004); (2) no alert from an INDICATOR or from the price SERIES; (3) the standalone alert sheet does not pre-fill.

target: Long-press on the bare plot area
action: Long-press the price pane for 750ms with no tool active, then release
response: Nothing. The interactive-element count was 16 before the press, 16 during the hold, and 16 after release. No crosshair menu, no price-level actions, no plus affordance.
result: UCT HAS NO LONG-PRESS ACTION ON THE CHART ITSELF
url: self-measured live; DOM element census taken at all three moments
notes: THE CLEANEST P2 GAP, measured. TradingView spends long-press on the single richest read available (full OHLCV + exact date + exact price) and then hangs a five-item pre-filled action menu off it (TV-IOS-CHART-0018, TV-IOS-ALERT-0003). UCT spends long-press on nothing. Note this is NOT a coarse-pointer artefact: ChartContextMenu.jsx gates on useIsTouch, which is width-based and TRUE in this harness (UCT-METHOD-0002), so if a chart context menu existed for the bare plot area it would have fired. ROOT CAUSE = MISSING_CAPABILITY. ⭐ HIGH VALUE, because UCT already owns both halves — it has a working crosshair (UCT-CHART-0005) and it has a context-menu component with 'Set alert…' in it (UCT-DRAW-0003). What is missing is the wire between them.

action: Move a REAL pointer over the price pane and read every legend node in the DOM
response: The crosshair works: a dashed vertical line, a price badge on the scale (335.28), a date badge on the time axis (Tue 12 Aug '25), and a volume-pane legend reading 'Vol 228K  $ Vol $62.1M  Avg 50D 209K'. A DOM query for every node whose class matches /legend/i returns EXACTLY ONE node: _volLegend_. There is no OHLC legend node at all.
result: ⭐ THE CROSSHAIR READS PRICE, DATE AND THREE VOLUME METRICS — AND NO OPEN, HIGH, LOW OR CLOSE
url: self-measured live; single-legend-node result confirmed by class query while the crosshair was active
notes: ⭐ A GENUINELY MIXED RESULT, and I nearly recorded it wrong. My first attempt used SYNTHETIC pointer events, saw no legend, and would have concluded 'UCT has no crosshair readout on touch'. That was a HARNESS failure — lightweight-charts does not receive dispatched events the way the overlay does. A real pointer produced the crosshair immediately. ⛔ Verify with the product's own answer, never with the absence of a synthetic response. WHAT IS ACTUALLY TRUE: UCT is BEHIND on price (TradingView's long-press gives O/H/L/C plus change plus change% plus volume; UCT gives none of the four prices) and AHEAD on volume (UCT gives $ Vol and Avg 50D, neither of which TradingView shows). Also relevant: MobileChartsApp.jsx sets alwaysShowLegend:false with a comment stating the legend is deliberately 'a crosshair INSPECTION tool, not' an always-on readout — so the design intent matches TradingView; the OHLC row simply is not in it. ROOT CAUSE = MISSING_CAPABILITY, and it looks cheap: crosshairData already carries the fields.

target: Can a dedicated research account do this research?
action: Check FREE_PAGES before creating a test account
response: AuthGuard.jsx: const FREE_PAGES = ['/morning-wire']. A non-paid, non-admin user hitting any other route is redirected to FREE_HOME = '/morning-wire'. /charts is NOT free.
result: ⛔ A FRESH RESEARCH ACCOUNT CANNOT REACH /charts AT ALL
notes: ⛔ RECORDED BECAUSE IT DECIDED A METHOD CHOICE. The owner authorised creating a dedicated research account rather than using their own. Creating one would have produced a user that bounces straight off the surface under study; the only ways to make it work are adding its address to ADMIN_EMAILS on the production pod or writing a subscription row into the production auth DB — both are production entitlement/security changes the same instruction forbade. So no account was created, and the measurement continued in the already-authenticated session at a 390px frame. ⚠️ SEPARATE FINDING WORTH FILING: CLAUDE.md states 'Free tier: Dashboard, Breadth, Charts, Options Flow, Journal, Model Book accessible without payment'. The code says the free tier is Morning Wire alone. That is exactly the hand-typed-list-beside-the-thing-that-owns-it drift the repo documents elsewhere, and it is in the section a new engineer reads first.

target: Stated limits of the UCT measurement, v2
action: Record what this harness can and cannot establish
response: A 390x844 same-origin frame on production satisfies (max-width:640px) and (max-width:1024px), so the phone shell, Sheet, ContextPopover, TickerActions and ChartContextMenu are all the real touch-branch components. It does NOT satisfy (pointer: coarse). An attempt to override the pointer media query was refused by the environment's safety classifier and was not worked around.
result: ⚠️ EIGHT ChartDrawingOverlay BEHAVIOURS REMAIN UNTESTED, AND FOUR OF THEM ARE P1
notes: ⚠️ THE HONEST STATE OF THE P1 COMPARISON. Untested because coarse-gated: the 15px vs 8px grab radius, the 7px vs 4px handle with halo, auto-select-after-placement, the touch wrapper effect, the tap-two-points coach chip, DrawingQuickBar, and the sheet presentation of the drawing context menu. FOUR of those are the exact behaviours that decide whether UCT matches TradingView's 'the tap is a draft you immediately adjust' model — so the P1 verdict is currently UNRESOLVED IN UCT'S FAVOUR, not settled against it. ⛔ Do NOT write a P1 backlog item until this is tested on a real coarse pointer. Two routes exist: a real device pointed at production (blocked by the paid gate on /charts, see UCT-ACCESS-0001) or a local sandbox served to a real device over BrowserStack Local, using tools/e2e_sandbox_launcher.py, which sets ADMIN_EMAILS for exactly this purpose and touches no production data.
